mapper.select: SELECT b.num, b.title, b.price, b.author, b.page, COUNT(r.book_num) AS cnt FROM book b LEFT JOIN review r ON b.num = r.book_num GROUP BY b.num;
select * from book order by ${key} desc
select * from book where title like CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') or author like CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
mapper.insert: insert into book(title, price, author, page) values(#{title},#{price},#{author},#{page})
mapper.select: select * from review where book_num=#{book_num} order by created_at desc
